lesson.intro: We use the simple past tense for actions that [[already happened]] and are finished.
points: Verbs ending in e add -d: like → [[liked]]. Short verbs may double the last letter: stop → [[stopped]].
Consonant + y → change y to i and add -ed: cry → [[cried]].
Irregular verbs change: go → [[went]], eat → [[ate]], see → [[saw]], buy → [[bought]], write → [[wrote]].
Negative and questions use did + base verb: I [[did not go]]. [[Did]] you [[see]] it?
Signal words: yesterday, last night, last week, two days ago, in 2020.

examples.text: I [[went]] to the market last Sunday.
They [[did not watch]] TV last night.

lesson.tip: After "did" or "did not", always use the base verb: Did you see? (not "saw").
